name: Green Acres
summary: Green Acres Mall is a major enclosed shopping center in Valley Stream featuring over 150 stores, diverse dining options, and free parking. This Long Island destination offers a comprehensive retail experience with national chains, specialty shops, and family-friendly amenities.
demographics: Green Acres Mall serves a diverse, middle-income demographic in Nassau County, with a strong representation of families and value-conscious shoppers from Valley Stream and surrounding Long Island communities. The trade area attracts a multi-generational customer base spanning young families, working professionals, and retirees, with household incomes ranging from moderate to upper-middle class. Shoppers are drawn to the center's mix of affordable fashion, dining options, and convenient free parking, with typical visitors seeking both everyday necessities and weekend entertainment shopping experiences.
description: Green Acres Mall stands as one of Long Island's premier shopping destinations, serving the Valley Stream community and greater Nassau County since its opening. This fully enclosed regional shopping center features over 150 stores spread across multiple levels, offering an extensive mix of national retailers, specialty shops, and diverse dining options that cater to every taste and budget. The mall's convenient location on Green Acres Road East, combined with ample free parking, makes it a go-to destination for families and shoppers throughout the region. Anchored by major department stores and complemented by popular fashion retailers, electronics stores, and entertainment venues, Green Acres provides a comprehensive shopping experience under one roof. With operating hours from 11 AM to 9 PM daily and a strong 4.2-star rating from over 34,000 reviews, the center has established itself as a trusted community gathering place where Long Islanders can shop, dine, and socialize in a comfortable climate-controlled environment.
